descriptors.name: cdm.party.EntityIdentifier
descriptors.label: Entity Identifier
descriptors.description: An identifier and its source for a legal entity. Ported from CDM cdm.base.staticdata.party.EntityIdentifier; embedded inline by LegalEntity.

identifier.name: identifier
identifier.label: Identifier
identifier.description: The identifier value, e.g. the LEI string (20 alphanumeric characters when the type is LEI).

identifierType.name: identifierType
identifierType.label: Identifier Type
identifierType.description: The identifier's source type — the CDM EntityIdentifierTypeEnum values: BIC, LEI, MIC, REDID, COUNTRY_CODE, OTHER.
